A few practical questions

Before you begin.

Is this a live subscription service?

No. Evade Research is a course and portfolio project. The website demonstrates a proposed newsletter, a historical sample and a browser-only signup flow. There is no active subscriber database, checkout or email service.

Is the research up to date?

Issue 001 is a working draft with a 28 October 2026, 19:50 UTC cutoff; the US session was still open then. The historical pilot has a separate 14 June 2024 cutoff. The planned Sunday review uses completed-week observations after checking the sources and editorial argument.

Who is the newsletter designed for?

Young and new investors, finance students and curious readers who want an accessible explanation of macroeconomic developments and their possible relationship with broad US and European equity indices.

What does the proposed €8/month cover?

It is a test price for a proposed weekly macro newsletter, including market context, source-linked interpretation and a learning section. It is a business-model assumption. No purchase or recurring billing is available.

Does Evade Research give investment recommendations?

The project provides general educational research. It does not assess your circumstances or provide personal investment advice. Examples and scenarios are used to explain mechanisms, not to promise returns or recommend trades.
